observable_failure_step.description: Agent drafted 10_hypothesis_5.md and 10_hypothesis_5.docx text but omitted the extraction and inclusion of required statistical parameters (beta, p, z) from 10_hypothesis_5.json.

root_cause_diagnosis: The agent generated the narrative text for Hypothesis 5 deliverables (.md and .docx) but failed to dynamically inject the primary test statistics (like beta, SE, z, and p-values) from the companion JSON payload into the paragraphs, violating the rule that text must explicitly report test statistics.
prescribed_behavior: When drafting narrative deliverables (.md, .docx) from statistical JSON payloads, the writer agent must explicitly parse the 'primary_statistic' or structural path coefficients (B, SE, beta, z, p) and embed them directly into the running text of the report.
